title: First Solar Inc.
summary: US maker of cadmium-telluride thin-film solar modules for utility-scale projects.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Detailed fundamental analysis and growth catalysts for First Solar Inc. (FSLR) are currently under review.

Future Tech Roadmap

Solar PV Panel (Silicon) Confirmed Ongoing
Photovoltaic conversion of sunlight; ~25% commercial efficiency, <$0.20/W
📈 First Solar manufactures CdTe thin-film panels (not silicon), giving it a cost advantage over Chinese silicon competitors and trade protection benefits.
MONOPOLY · 90% no direct rivals identified
